text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — drafting a compact enablement check-in script for AMs to run during trial kickoff. Goal: reduce early latency, surface renewal risk, and capture quick feedback. Shareable + pasteable.
Priya (Solutions): love that. can we include a single-command prefill and a short checklist AMs can run during kickoff?
Maya (CS): yes — topline checklist first: short bullets AMs can follow during the 1st call.
Maya (CS): • Run tenant prefill to warm KV and template caches (recent templates + last 50 msgs).
Maya (CS): • Create a small warm pool: reserve 2 sessions for first 24h, then scale down.
Maya (CS): • Set client-side retry with jitter and enable streaming fallback for UX spikes.
Maya (CS): • Monitor early token burn and enable quantized-model fallback if unit cost exceeds threshold.
Liam (SRE): ops note: use autoscale min=2 for first 24h, then back to min=0. Add health checks on warm pool creation.
Evan (PM): for interactive chat, recommend telling customers to use batch_size=2. Is that OK for general guidance?
Priya (Solutions): yep — batch_size=2 for live chat, batch_size=8 for async reranking/bulk jobs. Mention request shaping for long contexts.
Maya (CS): sample prefill curl (paste into AM runbook):
Maya (CS): ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME_TRIAL","items":[{"type":"template","id":"welcome_v1"},{"type":"history","last_n":50}]}'
```
Priya (Solutions): small note: run only once per tenant per 24h to avoid duplicate token usage. Add a polite UX blurb for the customer.
Maya (CS): streaming recommendations for CSM-facing apps:
Maya (CS): - Prefer SSE/WebSocket streaming for end-to-end latency. If not possible, fall back to incremental short-polling.
Maya (CS): - Cache first 128 tokens of common templates (prefix caching) to shave latency for the first bytes.
Liam (SRE): telemetry: add alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p99 streaming latency > 1200ms. Also track prefill failures per-tenant.
Evan (PM): renewal risk mapping: add a pulse check at day 7 — if query volume drops >40% vs day 1-3, schedule enablement outreach.
Maya (CS): quick AM checklist to paste into the customer's kickoff notes:
Maya (CS): - Prefill: last_prefill_at < 24h? (yes/no)
Maya (CS): - Warm pool: min_sessions >= 2 in last 24h? (yes/no)
Maya (CS): - Streaming errors <1% last 24h? (yes/no)
Maya (CS): - Eval prompts captured >=5? (yes/no)
Priya (Solutions): suggested customer-facing copy: "We ran a light prefill to accelerate your first 100 replies — this helps response quality and speed. Reply here if you prefer we don’t run it."
Evan (PM): add to renewal playbook as the "early activation" touchpoint and mark cadence for 14d follow-up.
Maya (CS): ops tip: when running prefill during demos, ask @oncall-bot to silence deploy noise for 30m for that tenant.
Liam (SRE): example oncall command: `oncall-bot mute deploys 30m tenant:ACME_TRIAL` — include in internal runbook.
oncall-bot: OK — deploy alerts muted for 30 minutes for tenant:ACME_TRIAL :white_check_mark:
Priya (Solutions): I’ll add the 1-pager + curl to the template library and update the kickoff email template.
Maya (CS): great — I’ll draft the internal doc and tag @Evan for renewal mapping. Thanks all. :pray:
